breakdown.description: The prompt makes the torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is also maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated that the torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface. The generated specification correctly includes the torsional shear stress τ = 27.96 MPa in the stress state analysis (part b and c), treating both bending normal stress and torsional shear stress as non-zero at the outer surface, which matches the ground truth prompt's approach.
